name: Stimpak: Diluted
blurb: How to obtain Stimpak: Diluted — crafting recipe, ingredients, vendors and any world sources. Directions and photos are added by hand.

creatures.note: Around 9,632 creatures can drop Stimpak: Diluted as generic loot; they are not listed individually. See the Containers expand for the per-container drop rates and How to Obtain for the crafting recipe.

consumption.note: Stimpak: Diluted is a chem consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
